defaults.author: Ayoub Yatouji
defaults.safetyNotes: Demonstration resource. Review the content, permissions, and any external actions before use. Never paste secrets or private customer data into a model or workflow.
installationGuide: Download the listed file and inspect it before use.
Replace every example value with information you are authorized to use.
Test manually on non-sensitive sample data before adapting it to a real project.

resources.title: SEO Audit Agent Prompt
resources.description: A structured assistant prompt for reviewing user-provided technical and on-page SEO evidence without claiming to crawl a website.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; platform behavior varies.
examples: Paste a page title, canonical, robots directive, and a short Search Console export; request prioritized findings.
resources.safetyNotes: This prompt does not crawl URLs or connect to Search Console. Verify every finding against the source data; do not share credentials or private analytics exports.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Copy its instruction block into a compatible chat or adapt it to a reviewed agent runtime.
Provide only public URLs or redacted, authorized evidence.

resources.title: Keyword Research Agent Prompt
resources.description: A research framework that groups supplied search terms by intent and flags assumptions instead of inventing volume or difficulty.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; keyword metrics must come from a verified source.
examples: Provide an authorized CSV of queries and ask for intent labels, topic groups, and unanswered questions.
resources.safetyNotes: The prompt cannot fetch search volumes. It must label missing metrics as unavailable and never infer real demand from guesses.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Paste the prompt into a supported chat model.
Supply a small, clean, authorized keyword sample and validate every cluster.

resources.title: SEO Content Brief and Writer Prompt
resources.description: A practical prompt for turning an approved brief into a source-aware outline and draft, with a fact-checking stop before publication.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; an approved editorial brief and source material.
examples: Provide audience, intent, product facts, and approved sources; request an outline before a draft.
resources.safetyNotes: Drafts require human review, original expertise, source verification, and rights checks. Do not publish unverified claims or copied material.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Add an approved brief and first-party sources.
Review the outline and claims before asking for a draft.

resources.title: GEO Visibility Review Prompt
resources.description: A cautious framework for checking whether supplied content is clear, attributable, and useful to answer engines; it does not promise citations.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; approved page text and source references.
examples: Ask it to identify unsupported claims, unclear entities, and questions a page does not answer.
resources.safetyNotes: No model citation or ranking is guaranteed. Treat suggestions as editorial hypotheses and verify against official search guidance.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Provide only public or approved content.
Review suggested changes with a subject-matter editor.

resources.title: Competitor Research Agent Prompt
resources.description: A framework for comparing public, user-supplied competitor pages and separating observed facts from hypotheses.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; public competitor material collected lawfully.
examples: Compare supplied landing-page headlines, offers, and content gaps in a source-linked table.
resources.safetyNotes: Do not bypass access controls, scrape restricted data, or infer private strategy. Clearly label observations and hypotheses.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Add public URLs or excerpts you are authorized to analyze.
Check every quoted statement against its original source.

resources.title: Ads Campaign Planning Assistant
resources.description: A planning prompt for matching an advertising objective, audience, creative test, and measurement plan before campaign setup.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; current platform policies and campaign objectives.
examples: Provide a goal, region, audience, and budget range; request a test plan and measurement checklist.
resources.safetyNotes: Platform interfaces and policies change. Verify targeting, claims, consent, and tracking settings in the official platform before launch.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Add campaign context without personal data.
Review policy and measurement guidance before implementing.

resources.title: E-commerce SEO Product Page Reviewer
resources.description: A review prompt for supplied product-page copy, taxonomy, and technical metadata, with checks for factual accuracy and duplication.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; product facts approved by the business.
examples: Review a supplied product description for missing attributes, duplicate wording, and unsupported claims.
resources.safetyNotes: Never invent product specifications, availability, reviews, or structured data values. Verify all details with the product owner.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Supply approved product facts and a page excerpt.
Review proposed copy and schema with the product owner.

resources.title: Lead Qualification and Brief Assistant
resources.description: A privacy-conscious prompt for organizing voluntarily supplied business enquiries into a reviewable qualification brief.
dependencies: A chat model that accepts text instructions; a lawful process for handling enquiry data.
examples: Turn a redacted enquiry into a summary of need, timeline, and missing follow-up questions.
resources.safetyNotes: Use only with consent and an approved data-handling policy. Remove personal identifiers before using public AI services.
installationGuide: Open the Markdown file.
Replace the example fields with a privacy-approved process.
Test with fictional or redacted enquiries only.

resources.title: Technical SEO Audit Skill
resources.description: A Claude Skills-format SKILL.md for organizing crawl, indexability, canonical, and performance evidence into prioritized checks.
dependencies: A runtime that supports the documented SKILL.md format for full skill loading.
examples: Summarize supplied crawl exports into issue, evidence, impact, and next verification step.
resources.safetyNotes: The skill analyzes supplied evidence only; it does not crawl or modify sites. Validate recommendations before implementation.
installationGuide: Keep the folder name and SKILL.md together.
Install only in a runtime whose current documentation supports this format.
Otherwise open SKILL.md and reuse it as a manual checklist.

resources.title: SEO Content Optimization Skill
resources.description: A reusable skill for reviewing a brief, page structure, search intent, internal links, and source quality without keyword stuffing.
dependencies: A runtime that supports the documented SKILL.md format for full skill loading.
examples: Review an existing draft and return evidence-based improvements with unchanged factual claims.
resources.safetyNotes: Human editorial review is required. Do not publish generated text or unverified claims automatically.
installationGuide: Keep the folder name and SKILL.md together.
Use with a compatible SKILL.md runtime or as a manual Markdown checklist.
Provide approved sources and an editorial brief.

resources.title: Internal Linking Planner Skill
resources.description: A skill for mapping supplied pages to topic clusters and proposing descriptive internal links for human approval.
dependencies: A runtime that supports the documented SKILL.md format; a supplied URL or page inventory.
examples: Provide a small page inventory and ask for source page, target page, anchor, and rationale.
resources.safetyNotes: The skill cannot verify live links. Check every URL, relevance, and navigation impact before publishing.
installationGuide: Install the skill folder in a compatible runtime or use SKILL.md manually.
Supply a current page inventory.
Review proposed links and anchors before implementation.

resources.title: Meta Ads Copywriting Skill
resources.description: A structured skill for drafting multiple ad-copy angles from verified offers, audience context, and current platform requirements.
dependencies: A runtime that supports SKILL.md; verified product claims and current ad policies.
examples: Generate three clearly differentiated copy directions while preserving approved offer details.
resources.safetyNotes: Check current Meta policies, restricted categories, consent, and substantiation before publishing ads.
installationGuide: Install in a compatible SKILL.md runtime or use as a manual prompt.
Supply only substantiated offer claims.
Have a person review policy and creative before launch.

resources.title: Google Ads Keyword Grouping Skill
resources.description: A skill for grouping supplied paid-search terms by intent and proposing a reviewable campaign structure.
dependencies: A runtime that supports SKILL.md; authorized keyword data from a verified source.
examples: Provide terms and labels from Keyword Planner; request suggested groups and negative-keyword review questions.
resources.safetyNotes: No search volume or cost estimates are generated. Confirm match types, policies, and settings in Google Ads.
installationGuide: Install in a compatible SKILL.md runtime or use SKILL.md manually.
Use current, authorized keyword data.
Review every group and negative-keyword suggestion before import.

resources.title: Schema Markup Review Skill
resources.description: A skill for drafting and checking JSON-LD structure against supplied page facts and official schema documentation.
dependencies: A runtime that supports SKILL.md; verified page facts and relevant schema documentation.
examples: Review a supplied Article JSON-LD object and flag mismatches with visible page content.
resources.safetyNotes: Never invent reviews, ratings, prices, or claims. Validate output with official tools and keep markup consistent with the page.
installationGuide: Install in a compatible SKILL.md runtime or use manually.
Provide visible page facts and source type.
Validate and compare the result with the rendered page before deployment.

resources.title: GEO Content Clarity Skill
resources.description: A skill for improving entity clarity, answer structure, attribution, and evidence in supplied content without promising AI visibility.
dependencies: A runtime that supports SKILL.md; reviewed content and attributable sources.
examples: Identify vague entities and unsupported claims in a provided page, then suggest clearer wording.
resources.safetyNotes: No AI citation, ranking, or inclusion outcome is guaranteed. Preserve accuracy and editorial judgment.
installationGuide: Install in a compatible SKILL.md runtime or use manually.
Supply the content and its sources.
Review all changes and preserve relevant context.

resources.title: Competitor Research Skill
resources.description: A skill for creating a source-linked comparison of public positioning, page structure, and content coverage.
dependencies: A runtime that supports SKILL.md; public source material collected lawfully.
examples: Compare user-supplied public landing pages and record the source URL for every observation.
resources.safetyNotes: Do not access restricted systems or collect personal data. Separate observed facts from interpretations.
installationGuide: Install in a compatible SKILL.md runtime or use manually.
Provide public, relevant sources.
Check observations against source pages and date them.

resources.title: n8n Campaign Brief Demo
resources.description: An inactive, importable n8n example that maps a manual trigger to fictional brief fields. It makes no API calls and stores no credentials.
dependencies: An n8n instance. No credentials are required for this demonstration.
examples: Run manually and inspect the fictional campaignName and status output.
inputs: A manual trigger with no external input or credentials.
outputs: A fictional campaignName and status field from the Set node.
resources.safetyNotes: This is a non-production demonstration, inactive by default. Inspect every node before activation; no external request or client data is included.
installationGuide: Download the JSON file.
In n8n, use Import from File and inspect the nodes.
Run with sample data only; add integrations only after reviewing credentials and data flows.

resources.title: n8n SEO Audit Preparation Starter
resources.description: An inactive manual workflow that turns a fictional site input into a review checklist; it does not crawl the site or call external APIs.
dependencies: An n8n instance. No credentials are required for this demonstration.
examples: Run manually to produce an example list of checks for review.
inputs: A manual trigger and a reserved example.invalid site URL.
outputs: A sample siteUrl and a textual checklist; no site is fetched.
resources.safetyNotes: The example URL is fictitious and is not fetched. Add HTTP or Search Console nodes only after security, privacy, and credential review.
installationGuide: Import the JSON into n8n.
Inspect node settings and run the inactive demo manually.
Replace the sample input and add any external data source only after review.

resources.title: n8n Search Console Report Input Template
resources.description: A non-connected workflow template for preparing a reporting request object before adding an approved Search Console integration.
dependencies: An n8n instance. A real Search Console connection requires OAuth setup not included here.
examples: Inspect the dateRange and propertyUrl fields produced by the manual workflow.
inputs: A manual trigger with placeholder propertyUrl and YYYY-MM-DD values.
outputs: A report-request object only; it does not connect to Google or retrieve data.
resources.safetyNotes: No Google connection or data retrieval is included. Never place OAuth tokens in the workflow JSON; use n8n credentials after reviewing access scope.
installationGuide: Import the JSON into a test n8n instance.
Confirm the sample property URL and date range are placeholders.
Configure OAuth using n8n's credential manager only if you choose to extend it.

resources.title: JavaScript UTM Link Builder
resources.description: A small browser-safe helper that validates an HTTP(S) URL and adds campaign parameters without making a network request.
dependencies: A browser with the URL API.
examples: buildUtmUrl('https://example.com', {source:'newsletter', medium:'email', campaign:'launch'})
resources.safetyNotes: The helper does not send the URL anywhere. Do not include personal data in tracking parameters.
installationGuide: Download the JavaScript file.
Import buildUtmUrl into a browser module or copy the function.
Test with a non-sensitive URL and your team's UTM naming convention.

resources.title: Python CSV Metrics Summary
resources.description: A standard-library script that reads a local CSV and summarizes numeric columns; it does not connect to APIs or upload data.
dependencies: Python 3.10 or later; standard library only.
examples: Run locally with a CSV path you own; inspect the summary before using it in a report.
resources.safetyNotes: The script reads a user-supplied local file. Review the path and data sensitivity first; it does not transmit data.
installationGuide: Install Python 3.10 or later.
Download the script.
Run `python csv-metrics-summary.py path/to/your.csv` from a terminal after reviewing the file.

resources.title: Article JSON-LD Template
resources.description: A valid JSON template with clearly marked placeholders for an Article structured-data object.
dependencies: Replace every placeholder with visible, accurate page information.
examples: Use as a starting point for an article page, then validate the output against the rendered page.
resources.safetyNotes: Do not add fabricated ratings, reviews, dates, authorship, or facts. Structured data must match visible content.
installationGuide: Download and edit the JSON file.
Validate it as JSON.
Adapt it to the actual article and test with Google's Rich Results Test.

resources.title: JavaScript Explicit HTTP Request Template
resources.description: A browser fetch example that makes the endpoint and user action explicit, handles HTTP errors, and never includes credentials.
dependencies: A public HTTPS endpoint that allows browser CORS, or a separately configured server.
examples: Call the function only from a user-initiated handler after replacing the example endpoint.
resources.safetyNotes: This template sends a network request when called. Review the destination, data, CORS, privacy, and terms; never embed private API keys in public browser code.
installationGuide: Review the endpoint placeholder.
Use only a public, authorized HTTPS endpoint.
Call the function from a deliberate user action and inspect response handling.

resources.title: Read-only Marketing Report SQL
resources.description: A read-only example query that aggregates campaign metrics by source and month from a clearly illustrative table schema.
dependencies: A database with a reviewed campaign_metrics table; table and column names are illustrative.
examples: Review the SELECT query and adapt table names to a read-only reporting view.
resources.safetyNotes: The provided query is SELECT-only. Review schema, access permissions, and data privacy before running against a real database.
installationGuide: Download and inspect the query.
Adapt it to a read-only view and your SQL dialect.
Test on a non-sensitive sample dataset.
